description: Gemalen Den Haag is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Beschrijving: Gemalen behorend tot het rioleringsnetwerk van de Gemeente Den Haag, conform het gegevenswoordenboek stedelijk water (GWSW) van stichting Rioned. Verwijzing: en: Kaartviewer:. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Space and infrastructure. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
